title: API 504s caused by database connection exhaustion from a manually started re-indexing job
example_questions: Why were users getting 504 errors on 2026-10-01 around 14:20?
What happened to the portal API between 14:00 and 15:00 on 2026-10-01?
Was the database involved in the errors on the afternoon of 2026-10-01?

timeline.what: Worker starts a profile re-indexing job (triggered manually)
Postgres connections climb from 34 to 97 of 100
API connection pool exhausted; Postgres refuses new clients
Job finishes, connections drop to 31, errors stop

key_findings.name: links it to the re-indexing job
notes recovery when the job finished

facts: API connection pool timeouts from 14:16:30; Postgres 'too many clients' from 14:16:45
Postgres connections 34 -> 97 of 100 between 14:00 and 14:15:40, back to 31 at 14:31:40
inferences: The re-indexing job held database connections, starving the API (timing, not proof)
missing_evidence: Who started the job and why
recommended_actions: Run re-indexing off-peak or with a connection limit

decoys.why_benign: The metrics agent's push timeouts happen all afternoon, before and after the incident
The lobby camera dropped for 3 minutes at 14:20: coincidence, unrelated to the API
